description: This file defines the ProcStat struct and associated methods for reading and parsing process status information from /proc/[pid]/stat in Linux systems, as part of the 'procfs' package in the Prometheus project.

classes.name: ProcStat
classes.description: Struct holding process status information read from /proc/[pid]/stat.

methods.name: Proc.Stat
methods.description: Reads and parses the process's /proc/[pid]/stat file to populate ProcStat fields.

methods.name: Proc.NewStat
methods.description: Deprecated method that calls Proc.Stat to get process status.

methods.name: ProcStat.VirtualMemory
methods.description: Returns the virtual memory size in bytes.

methods.name: ProcStat.ResidentMemory
methods.description: Calculates resident memory in bytes based on RSS pages and system page size.

methods.name: ProcStat.StartTime
methods.description: Calculates the process start time in Unix timestamp seconds.

methods.name: ProcStat.CPUTime
methods.description: Returns total CPU time in seconds (user + system).
